name: The Ways Summer Goes
source:
The Ways Summer Goes tells the story of two destinies that will cross paths. Jennifer, a secretary working in one of the most renowned companies in the country, will meet Arthur (MC), the new CEO assigned to this branch where Jennifer works. Your decisions could totally change the course of this story.
Take control of the situation and find out what fate has in store for our protagonists.
